blocks.text: AI-powered LinkedIn growth for professionals and founders

Taplio focuses exclusively on LinkedIn growth - a specificity that makes it significantly more useful than generic social media tools for professionals building their LinkedIn presence. The AI understands LinkedIn's content patterns, engagement mechanics, and algorithm preferences.

The content creation features are tailored to what performs on LinkedIn. AI generates post ideas based on trending topics in your industry, suggests hooks and formats that drive engagement, and can transform long-form content into LinkedIn-optimized posts. For busy professionals, this reduces content creation from hours to minutes.

The lead generation features connect your LinkedIn presence to business outcomes. Identify and engage with your ideal prospects, track profile visits, and export leads - turning LinkedIn from a content platform into a sales channel.
Generate LinkedIn posts using AI trained on high-performing content
Queue and schedule posts with optimal timing suggestions
Find and engage prospects based on job title, company, and activity
Post performance, profile views, and follower growth tracking
Manage comments and relationships with key connections
Browse viral posts in your industry for ideas and trends
For B2B founders and professionals, LinkedIn is often the highest-ROI marketing channel. Taplio makes consistent, effective LinkedIn presence manageable alongside the demands of running a business.
Our team can integrate Taplio into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
